theme_rankings.why_now: 토큰 가격은 하락했지만 매출 폭증 중. AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출 직접.
theme_rankings.risk: 토큰 인플레이션 압력 + 사용자 보상 의존. 베어 마켓에서 매도 압력 큼.

theme_rankings.why_now: 실제 매출 + 토큰 보유자 환원. P/S 가시화로 밸류에이션 재평가 단계.
theme_rankings.risk: 스마트컨트랙트 위험 + 규제. 매출은 시장 변동성에 큰 폭으로 변동.

theme_rankings.tagline: 📈 ETF 승인 후보 + 이더 L2 — 기관 매집 영역
theme_rankings.why_now: SOL·LTC ETF 가능성 + L2 거래량 회복. 다음 cycle 메이저 후보.
theme_rankings.risk: ETF 미승인 시 단기 조정. L2는 fee market 경쟁 심화.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🥇 시장 방향성 기준 — 비트는 디지털 금, 이더는 인프라
theme_rankings.why_now: BTC ETF 자금 유입, ETH 스테이킹 + L2 매출. 알트 사이클의 출발점.
theme_rankings.risk: 거시 유동성·금리에 직접 노출. ETF 자금 흐름이 단기 방향성을 좌우.

theme_rankings.why_now: 기관 자금 유입 가장 빠른 영역. BlackRock·Franklin 등 진입.
theme_rankings.risk: 규제 의존적. 거시 금리 환경 변화 시 단기 자금 이탈 가능.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🌐 검증된 L1 — 이더 외 실수요 입증된 체인들
theme_rankings.why_now: 솔라나 압도적 점유 + 신흥 L1(Sui·Aptos)도 자금 유입. 생태계 prop value 확보.
theme_rankings.risk: L1 간 경쟁 격화. 사용자·개발자 이탈 시 멀티플 빠르게 축소.

theme_rankings.tagline: 🤖 크립토 버전 AI 베팅 — 분산 컴퓨팅·에이전트
theme_rankings.why_now: AI Capex 사이클의 크립토 노출. 미국 AI 주식 테마와 동행 흐름.
theme_rankings.risk: 내러티브 의존도 큼. 실수요 검증 아직 미흡. 알트 변동성 폭.

theme_rankings.why_now: 거버넌스보단 실제 트래픽·결제 사용처. TON·BNB 일일 활성 유저 검증.
theme_rankings.risk: 투기 대비 변동성 낮지만 폭발력도 작음. 환희장에서 underperform.

top_news.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Sept. 4
top_news.summary: Oil headed for its biggest weekly gain since July as renewed US-Iran hostilities heightened concerns about prolonged disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

top_news.title: Hong Kong’s Picky IPO Issuers Rewrite Playbook for Allocations
top_news.summary: Hong Kong’s boom in initial public offerings has turned getting shares in the hottest deals into something of an invitation-only affair.

top_news.title: Anthropic Nears Finalizing $15 Billion Pre-IPO Credit Facility
top_news.summary: Anthropic PBC is set to finalize expanding its revolving credit facility to $15 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, clearing a hurdle before the artificial intelligence firm’s public filing for its highly anticipated IPO.

top_news.title: SEC Moves to Nix Rule on Adviser Political Donations
top_news.summary: Investment advisers would no longer be prohibited from offering services to public pension funds if they made recent political donations to state and local elected officials, the Securities and Exchange Commission said in a proposed rule change Thursday.

top_news.title: Asia Stocks to Gain as Fed Bets Cool, Dollar Drops: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks in Asia were poised to rise Friday, tracking gains on Wall Street as investors pared bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike this month. The yen held its biggest gain in over a month and oil rose.

top_news.title: Stocks Climb as Fed-Hike Wagers Ease on Waller: Markets Wrap
top_news.summary: Stocks rose the most in a month as Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller said he’d be willing to support holding rates steady if price pressures continue to show signs of easing.

top_news.title: Wine Distributor Stephen Burton Gets Prison Term in Rare Vintage Scam
top_news.summary: The founder of a London wine-distribution business was sentenced in the US to six years in prison for orchestrating a scam that cost investors almost $100 million and was based on bottles of rare vintages that didn’t exist.

top_news.title: Toyota’s Sato on How Japanese Automakers Stay Relevant
top_news.summary: Toyota Vice Chairman and Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association Chairman Koji Sato sits down for an exclusive Bloomberg Television interview with Shery Ahn to discuss how Japanese automakers can stay relevant globally, as well as Toyota's hydrogen business. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_news.title: IMF Mulls Opening Caracas Office as Venezuela Engagement Deepens
top_news.summary: The International Monetary Fund is considering opening a local office in Venezuela, establishing permanent representation in the country for the first time in years, according to people familiar with the matter.

top_news.title: UBS's Panseri on Global Bond Yields, ECB Hike Expectations
top_news.summary: UBS Wealth Management France CIO Claudia Panseri discusses the Yen as global bond yields surged on inflation concerns. She speaks with Lizzy Burden on Bloomberg TV. (Source: Bloomberg)
